original.statement: Loki Ruler no longer panics from concurrent read-write access of tenant configs when there are a large amount of rules.

decision.reason: [ev-22d171f57c1e] only states that a Ruler panic caused by concurrent read-write access of tenant configs (with many rules) was fixed. That is an internal concurrency fix, not wire/protocol behaviour, and it names no config key, flag, field, endpoint or other typed subject. So the protocol-behavior subject "tenant-config-concurrent-access" doesn't fit, and no other family's subject follows from the evidence.
